artworks.title: Portrait of a Woman
artworks.creditLine: Pepita Milmore Memorial Fund
artworks.description: The image depicts a seated woman in an ornate chair, visible from the knees up. She is seated with her arms resting on a table and a book, facing the camera. Her facial features include a long, oval face with a calm expression, and she has dark hair styled in tight ringlets on either side. She wears a floor-length, long-sleeved dress with a high collar and a white lace-edged chemisette peeking out at the neck and cuffs. Additionally, she is holding a newspaper in her lap, and a long chain is draped around her neck, falling onto her dress. The background is a plain, light-colored wall without any distinct features.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Woman
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Funds from Robert B. Menschel and the Vital Projects Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a woman standing with her hands resting above her waist. She has an oval face, delicate features, and her hair styled in an updo with a floral wreath. She is wearing an elaborate gown with lace and ruffle details, off-the-shoulder sleeves, a sash, a pearl necklace, and earrings. The background features tall, arched windows with patterned glass, and an artistic depiction of trees.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Man
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Funds from Robert B. Menschel and the Vital Projects Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a man standing with a relaxed posture, leaning slightly to one side while resting one hand in his trouser pocket. His other hand is on a walking stick. He has a composed expression, neatly groomed hair, and a mustache. He is dressed in a formal outfit consisting of dark trousers, a waistcoat with a patterned design, a bow tie, and an overcoat draped over his shoulders. There is a statuette on a pedestal next to him, depicting a figure in armor. The background features patterned wallpaper, a table beside him with a top hat and fabric items.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Woman
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Funds from Robert B. Menschel and the Vital Projects Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a woman standing in a full-length portrait. She is facing forward with one hand resting on a chair and the other holding a hat. She has dark, neatly styled hair and is wearing a light-colored dress under a dark embroidered cape with a ruffled collar. The background features a painted scenic backdrop of water, trees, and distant hills or mountains. The floor in the foreground has a patterned design.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Woman
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Funds from Robert B. Menschel and the Vital Projects Fund
artworks.description: The image depicts a young woman in a mid-19th century style dress. She stands facing the camera with her head turned slightly. Her dark hair is styled in loops or braids on each side. She has a neutral expression and clasped hands at her waist. The dress has decorative trim, a high neckline, and pleated/lace details on the sleeves. The backdrop has a patterned floor and a floral drape to the right of the woman.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Boy
artworks.medium: albumen silver print with applied color (carte-de-visite)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Funds from Robert B. Menschel and the Vital Projects Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a young boy seated on a cushioned stool, reading a book. He has short, curly brown hair and is wearing a dark outfit with a white collar. Beside him lies an overcoat or a piece of cloth on the stool. Nearby is a stack of blue books on a table. The background features a plain wall and a patterned rug on the floor.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Beggar Girl
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Funds from Robert B. Menschel and the Vital Projects Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a young girl seated on the ground, leaning against a large box. She has an oval face, dark hair, and delicate facial features. She wears a hooded cloak and holds a woven basket on her lap. In the background, there are some sheets of paper or thin material near the box.

artworks.title: Captain Alfred Ransom and Child
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Funds from Robert B. Menschel and the Vital Projects Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a man standing outdoors next to a small tree, while a child is sitting on a branch of the tree. The man is positioned with one hand on his hip and the other resting against the tree trunk. He has a mustache and is wearing a brimmed hat with short hair visible beneath it. The man is dressed in a dark suit with a vest and a tie, and there is a watch chain visible on his vest. The child sitting on the branch is wearing a light-colored dress. The background consists of a grassy area with some trees visible, and the photograph has a sepia tone.

artworks.title: Portrait of Two Men
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Funds from Robert B. Menschel and the Vital Projects Fund
artworks.description: The image shows two men. The man on the left is seated on a chair with a wooden backrest, holding an object and looking up towards the other man. He has a neatly styled mustache and short, slicked-back hair. He is dressed in a dark coat with light-colored trousers and holds a bowler hat in his lap. The other man stands beside a round table covered with a patterned cloth, looking down at the seated man. He has a similar mustache and neatly combed hair. He is wearing a matching dark suit with a bow tie and a white pocket square. In the foreground, next to the seated man, is a large camera or a similar box-shaped device. The background is plain and features a partial view of a tasseled drapery on the left side of the image.

artworks.title: Gray Wolf
artworks.creditLine: Robert B. Menschel Fund
artworks.description: The man is depicted from the waist up, sitting on a chair. His face includes strong cheekbones, deep-set eyes, and a serious expression. He has hair styled into two braids, wears a light-colored long-sleeved shirt over a darker, buttoned shirt, and pants made of a different material. The man is holding an object in his left hand and wears a necklace with a cross pendant. The background is plain and sepia-toned.

artworks.title: Olive Oatman
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Funds from Robert B. Menschel and the Vital Projects Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a woman standing upright, facing forward with her body turned slightly to the left. Her right arm rests on a decorative chair with an ornate upholstered back. She has a serious expression, clear eyes, and hair styled in ringlets with ribbons. She wears a long dress with a fitted bodice, buttons, and detailed sleeves and skirt. The background is a plain wall, and she stands on a patterned carpet.

artworks.title: William F.M. Arny with Apache and Ute Chiefs
artworks.creditLine: Robert B. Menschel Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a group portrait of sixteen men, with eight standing in the back row and eight seated in the front. Each person is shown from head to toe, featuring various hairstyles and clothing styles. The men exhibit diverse facial features. They are dressed in a mix of traditional and formal attire. Some men wear hats, and the background is a plain wall. The number '235' is displayed above the heads of the standing individuals.

artworks.title: View of the Loss of the Rhone
artworks.artist: Maria Catharina Prestel, after Louis Bélanger
artworks.medium: etching and aquatint printed in brown on laid paper
artworks.dimensions:
sheet (trimmed to platemark): 55.8 × 72.2 cm (21 15/16 × 28 7/16 in.)
image: 48 × 69.5 cm (18 7/8 × 27 3/8 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: The image features a landscape with a rocky gorge seen from an elevated point, with cliffs, trees, a natural bridge, and people crossing it. The artwork uses detailed brushstrokes to emphasize texture, with a sepia monochrome color palette creating a vintage atmosphere. In the distance, there are further geological formations and a river, while close-up, cascading waterfalls are depicted.

artworks.title: Charley voor Het Raam [Charley in Front of the Window]
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a girl in profile view from the shoulders up, appearing focused on something in front of her. She has long, wavy hair styled with loose curls and a large bow on top. The girl's facial features are delicate and she seems absorbed in her task. She is wearing a patterned dress with puffed sleeves, with her hand resting on a surface, possibly a table, with the thumb on top of a paper. In the background, there is a harbor scene with ship masts, figures, a horse-drawn cart, and birds in the sky. The background is detailed with fine lines, adding depth to the portrait's setting.

artworks.title: Study Sheet with Portraits of Hans Hess and Albert Klesse
artworks.creditLine: Ruth and Jacob Kainen Memorial Acquisition Fund
artworks.description: The image shows dark, swirling lines and shapes forming an abstract composition resembling a layered portrait. Two faces are created by bold, shadowy strokes: one large face with a hat and obscured features, and another smaller face with clearer details. Light and dark areas create contrast in the image, connecting the elements to familiar forms like figures in thought or partially concealed by darkness.

artworks.title: Odysseue und die Sirenen (Odysseus and the Sirens)
artworks.medium: lithograph printed in color with gold on chine collé on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Ruth and Jacob Kainen Memorial Acquisition Fund

artworks.title: Le Café
artworks.medium: softground etching with roulette, printed in brown-black on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Purchased for the Virginia and Ira Jackson Collection
artworks.description: The image features multiple stylized figures dominating the scene. In the center, a seated figure is depicted from the waist up, facing slightly to the right. The figure has abstract facial features and hair tied up. They wear a flowing garment. Other figures are depicted around them, mainly from the shoulders up, with dark, flowing forms and fabrics. One figure to the right is seated at a table with small objects and glasses. The background is neutral with subtle texture, emphasizing the figures. The scene evokes a gathering or social setting, with a sense of complexity and intrigue.

artworks.title: Le Bar
artworks.medium: softground etching with aquatint and roulette, printed in brown on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Purchased for the Virginia and Ira Jackson Collection
artworks.description: This is a drawing of figures gathered in an intimate setting. The composition captures a group of stylized figures in close proximity. The etching predominantly employs darker tones and sharp lines to define the figures, resulting in a sketch-like effect with visible facial expressions and gestures. The setting appears to be a social gathering or a seated arrangement, where the characters are intricately detailed, with particular attention to facial features and clothing folds. There is a sense of movement and emotion conveyed through these interactions. The background remains abstract and undefined, focusing the viewer’s attention on the dynamic characters.

artworks.title: Two Sportsmen Mounting Their Horses
artworks.creditLine: Purchased for the Virginia and Ira Jackson Collection
artworks.description: The image shows a person wearing a tall hat leading a horse on a path. The perspective is slightly elevated, showing the figure and animals clearly. The horizon is high in the scene, with open land to the left. The sky on the right is depicted with expressive lines suggesting cloud formations. The etching technique is visible in the fine and bold lines rendering the landscape and figures with varied textures. The color palette is monochrome with dark lines against the light paper, creating a stark and graphic quality.

artworks.title: Allegory of Painting
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a person painting on a large canvas outdoors. The person has curly hair, wears a flowing garment, holds a paintbrush in their right hand, and a palette with paintbrushes in their left hand. There is a monkey figure seated in the foreground. The background features faint sketch-like drawings.

artworks.title: Jean-Philippe-Guy Le Gentil, Comte de Paroy, Expelled from David's Studio
artworks.artist: Pierre-Nolasque Bergeret (formerly Charles Porphyre Alexandre Desains)
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: This is a drawing of various figures and artistic tools in a chaotic scene. The image shows a room full of dynamic figures engaged in different activities related to art and construction. There are characters holding art tools such as palettes and paintbrushes, while others wield ladders, easels, and large pencils. The scene is lively, with the arrangement of bodies creating movement and action. One figure in the foreground appears to be sketching, while another poses dramatically. The drawing uses fine line work to convey detailed expressions and poses, contributing to the overall sense of energy and chaos.

artworks.title: The Draftsman (Le dessinateur)
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a figure seated on a cylindrical stone, holding a drawing pad and a pen or pencil. The person is in profile, with short curly hair, wearing a draped garment. Surrounding the figure are architectural elements, including a bridge with an arched underpass and a plinth with a draped statue. In the background, there is another statue and what appears to be the base of a large structure, possibly a pyramid.

artworks.title: Evening Gathering in the Palais Fries
artworks.medium: etching and aquatint printed in brown on wove paper
artworks.dimensions:
sheet (trimmed within platemark): 14 × 24 cm (5 1/2 × 9 7/16 in.)
image: 12.4 × 22.4 cm (4 7/8 × 8 13/16 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Ruth and Jacob Kainen Memorial Acquisition Fund
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an interior scene with a group of people gathered around a table. The room is illuminated by a central hanging lamp, casting light over a table where a large sheet of paper is prominently displayed. Around the table, several individuals appear to be engaged in discussion or observation, with some pointing towards the paper. The room is filled with numerous other figures, some standing and conversing in the background. The drawing employs soft shading and fine lines to create a sense of depth and interaction within the space.

artworks.title: Martin Luther
artworks.artist: Daniel Hopfer, after Lucas Cranach the Elder
artworks.creditLine: Ruth and Jacob Kainen Memorial Acquisition Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a bust portrait of a man in profile view. He is depicted with prominent facial features, short curly hair on the sides of his head, a large round cap, and a cloak or robe covering his shoulders and upper chest. The background has a textured and patterned design with rays or lines emanating from his head. Text is written at the bottom of the image.
